fields.title: Primary column
fields.description: The column with the value that will be used, unless it is missing.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Secondary column
fields.description: The column with the value that will be used if it is missing in the primary column.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Replace/append columns
fields.description:
Choose where to put the result column:
  • Replace primary and delete secondary: Replace the primary column with the merge result and remove the secondary column.
  • Replace primary: Replace the primary column with the merge result and keep the secondary column.
  • Replace secondary: Keep the primary column and replace the secondary column with the merge result.
  • Append as new column: Append a new column with the name provided below.

fields.title: New column name
fields.description: The name for the new column.
